name: TransMedics

logo.source: transmedics.com (official white wordmark recoloured to brand maroon #9E1C33 from the site icon, because only a white header logo is published; 1042x174)

description: TransMedics keeps donated hearts, lungs and livers alive and warm outside the body during transport (its Organ Care System, OCS) instead of packing them on ice, which widens the pool of usable donor organs. All three OCS products have FDA premarket approval. It sells the disposable kit for each organ (net product revenue) and also runs the National OCS Program (NOP), a service in which TransMedics itself arranges the organ retrieval, aviation and logistics for the transplant centre, using chartered and its own fixed-wing aircraft. The service is now 38.5% of revenue but earns a far lower margin than the devices. Operating profit rose to $108.6M in 2025 but fell in the first half of 2026 as research spending doubled.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge, not source-checked. SEC SIC code is 3845 (Electromedical & Electrotherapeutic Apparatus). It does not fit the box well: 38.5% of revenue is a logistics service.

businessLines.name: Net product revenue (OCS Heart, Lung, Liver disposables)
businessLines.how: One-time sale of a disposable kit to the transplant centre each time an organ is transported on OCS.
businessLines.description: Single-use perfusion sets and solutions used with the OCS console for each organ.

businessLines.name: Service revenue (National OCS Program)
businessLines.how: A per-case service fee for the end-to-end retrieval and flight logistics, with large pass-through costs (aircraft, pilots, fuel), so margins are far lower than the devices.
businessLines.description: TransMedics arranges organ retrieval, aviation transport and clinical support, and bills the transplant centre.

brands.name: OCS Heart, OCS Lung, OCS Liver
brands.note: All three have FDA PMA for organs from brain-death and circulatory-death donors (10-K)

brands.name: OCS Kidney
brands.note: Third-generation platform in development, no approval
